name: plugin-tereno
description: Pre-action safety, honeypot exit simulation, cabal holder clusters, chain reads, prediction evidence and ERC-8183 escrow evaluations for ElizaOS agents over x402 on Base: buy bounded verdicts (contract.guard, token.metadata, chain.snapshot, prediction.evidence, token.launch.guard, token.holders.guard) with per-call + daily USDC caps, fail-closed defaults, dry-run mode and seeder reuse dividends.

TERENO_PRIVATE_KEY.description: EVM private key of the wallet that pays x402 calls (needs USDC on Base). Falls back to EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

TERENO_MAX_PRICE_USD.description: Per-call USDC cap. Default 0.1, which covers the dearest check (token.launch.guard miss at $0.07). A lower value makes calls above the cap fail before payment.

TERENO_PRIVATE_ONLY.description: Set to true to refuse paid actions from public Discord/Telegram/Twitter sources.

TERENO_NETWORK.description: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet, default) or eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia).

TERENO_FAIL_MODE.description: closed (default) makes financial checks abort when the guard cannot answer; open degrades to review. Never auto-signs on failure.

TERENO_DRY_RUN.description: Set to true to simulate checks with no x402 payment (works with no wallet).

TERENO_TELEMETRY.description: Set to off to disable anonymous, allowlisted usage telemetry (hashed wallet only; never keys/prompts).

TERENO_EVIDENCE_INSTALLATION_ID.description: Optional stable random identifier for this agent installation. It is SHA-256 hashed only when resolving evidence received from another agent; never use a wallet or secret.
